Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Background illustration for an interactive secret page in a personal portfolio. It will be viewed full-width with interactive hotspots, so keep the room objects crisp, distinct, fully visible, and well separated.
Primary request: A beautiful cozy evening room illustration in the visual spirit of LoFi Girl: hand-painted anime background, realistic believable interior and furniture, subtly cartoonish human character, warm textured linework and rich soft shadows. A lived-in room belonging to Giulio, an Italian computer engineering student living in Aarhus, Denmark.
Composition: Wide landscape 16:9 image, ideally 1920 by 1080. A single complete room scene viewed mostly front-on from a slightly elevated position with restrained perspective. The left half has a wooden PC desk and one adult young man playing games, facing right. His appearance: short curly auburn-brown hair, round clear glasses, a short beard, black T-shirt, headphones; show his side profile. No other people. The monitor must be a large, fully visible nearly front-facing horizontal rectangle at approximately x34%-47%, y43%-59%, unobstructed by his head or hands. Its screen is an entirely flat uniform very dark blue with NO reflections, text, pictures or UI; the actual game will be added by the website. PC keyboard and mouse on desk; tower below.
Room backdrop: Amber plaster walls, dark wood floor, autumn evening, a large window on the left with soft rainy blue light, a believable Danish red brick roof city view and a few wind turbines in the distance. Warm desk lamp, small potted plants, mug on desk, books, a soft rust-red rug, a comfy green chair, notebook, a sweater tossed over a chair, small string lights. These normal objects should fill the room naturally without cluttering the specified objects.
Required identifiable objects and placement:
1. Three small fabric flags hanging together on a string across the upper middle wall, approximately x39%-63%, y14%-23%. Correct Italian tricolour, Danish white-cross-on-red flag, South African flag. Leave space around them for animation.
2. A slim racing road bicycle with drop handlebars hanging VERTICALLY on the upper-right wall, approximately x76%-87%, y12%-58%. Exactly two clean circular wheels clearly visible; the bicycle is rotated 90 degrees, one wheel above the other. Spokes well defined.
3. A small scrambled Rubik's cube on the desk near x36%, y65%, with visible top and two side faces.
4. A framed placeholder ankle X-ray on the wall approximately x62%, y40%; clearly bones of the ankle in white on dark blue-black film, no lettering.
5. A PAIR of black short-track speed-skating boots with very long polished bright sharp steel blades together on a shelf, approximately x62%-76%, y68%-78%. Two low boots, visibly LONG blade rails, not hockey skates.
6. A separate PAIR of black-and-red long-track speed-skating boots with extremely long silver clap blades and recognizable hinge at the toe, on the right shelf approximately x79%-95%, y68%-80%. Distinct from the first pair.
7. A PAIR of inline roller skates with four small wheels per boot on the floor lower-right, approximately x80%-93%, y86%-94%.
8. A PAIR of yellow-and-black climbing shoes with a small dark chalk bag on the floor approximately x62%-75%, y87%-94%.
9. A small upright white-and-black Falcon 9 rocket scale model with the white Dragon capsule on top on the right end of the desk at approximately x49%, y50%-65%.
10. A small LEGO-style red Ferrari Formula 1 model car parked on the desk beside the rocket at approximately x53%, y66%. Clearly a tiny F1 car with front and rear wings and four black wheels.
Style and mood: painterly traditional animation background with convincing proportions and object construction, cozy amber and burnt orange light, muted olive green and blue night, gentle nostalgia, highly finished illustration. Fine visible brush textures. No pixel art, no flat vector cartoon, no photorealistic 3D. Ensure props look like the actual specialized items.
Constraints: No text anywhere, no titles, no watermark, no web UI, no icons, no labels. Entire room visible inside image. Do not crop wheels, skates, shoes or model objects. Do not add cats, pets, extra people, duplicated monitors, or huge empty foreground. Keep the composition practical for a web scene; each object visually readable.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: a raster 2x2 contact sheet of four videogame screen illustrations for a tiny computer monitor in a cozy illustrated room. Generate ONE landscape image exactly divided into FOUR EQUAL RECTANGULAR QUADRANTS: two columns and two rows, no gaps, no borders, no frames, no margin. Each of the four quarters is itself a landscape screenshot scene. This is a gameplay preview asset, NOT a webpage. Width about 1600 and height about 900 so each quarter is 800x450.
Top-left quadrant: a recognizable Trackmania 2020 racing game screenshot. Rear chase camera behind a small green-and-white open-wheel racing car speeding along a smooth grey stadium track, blue sky, stadium stands, red-white edge curbs, green infield, a loop or steep banked racetrack in the distance. High-quality 3D racing game style, clear car centered in lower middle, speedometer style digits in lower right, minimal HUD.
Top-right quadrant: recognizable Hearthstone gameplay board viewed from directly overhead. Warm carved wooden fantasy card-game board with interactive detailed ornamental corners, opposing hero medallions top and bottom, 2 rows of oval creature cards facing each other on a parchment board, curved hand of colorful cards on the bottom edge, bright blue mana crystals on lower right, tiny attack-health medallions, Hearthstone's whimsical fantasy game-art aesthetic. A real-looking game board, not a poster or a row of arbitrary cards.
Bottom-left quadrant: recognizable Chess.com online gameplay screen dominated by a large sage-green and ivory 8x8 chessboard, with classic dark and white chess pieces in a plausible middle-game position, a small dark green sidebar to the right with opposing digital chess clocks, clean modern 2D chess game interface. Not a physical chessboard. Exactly eight files and eight ranks.
Bottom-right quadrant: a recognizable FEZ gameplay screenshot, pixel art. A tiny white cube-headed character Gomez wearing a red fez cap stands on top of a floating grass-and-stone island or tall cubic stone tower, clear turquoise-blue sky and fluffy pixel clouds, other grassy cube islands, a golden floating cube collectible. Pixel art with crisp square pixels, joyful bright colors, faithful tiny white character with bright red fez, a side-view 2D platformer with 3D cube scenery.
Constraints: All four quadrants must fill their allotted quarter edge to edge. No captions, no titles, no wordmark logos, no surrounding mockups, no room or desk, no laptop or monitor frames, no mixing scenes across quadrants. Render the four views distinctly and with their own game-appropriate visual styles.
